note: Chou et al. [2018] is cited by name at two distinct sites: once to support the claim that sparse formats can be decomposed by level (a specific finding that travels into the indexed stream design), and once to note extensibility with new data structures, making it a named multi-site reference whose findings are used to ground design choices.
title: Indexed Streams: A Formal Intermediate Representation for Fused Contraction Programs
